title: Fix Mcp App Not Rendering When Executed on Client
description: Fix MCP App not rendering when executed on client. Check mcp-app.md reference and ensure everything is set up correctly in compose/engine and compose/ui. Previous investigation confirmed server-side meta serialization is correct. Need to find and fix root cause in built HTML, client-side initialization, or ext-apps library usage.
summary:
Root cause: The `registerAppTool` helper from `@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/server` normalizes tool `_meta` to include BOTH the nested key `_meta.ui.resourceUri` AND the flat key `_meta["ui/resourceUri"]`. The `RESOURCE_URI_META_KEY` constant exported by the SDK is `"ui/resourceUri"` (flat). Compose's raw `@mcp.tool(meta={"ui": {"resourceUri": URI}})` only produced the nested key. Hosts looking for the flat key couldn't find the resource URI and therefore didn't render the MCP App UI.

Fix: Created `_APP_RESOURCE_META = {"ui": {"resourceUri": _APP_RESOURCE_URI}, "ui/resourceUri": _APP_RESOURCE_URI}` constant and updated all 9 tool decorators to use it. Added `ontoolcancelled` handler to match reference patterns. Rebuilt dist/mcp-app.html. All 164 engine tests pass.
